english: Ten observations $x_{1},x_{2},\dots,x_{10}$ satisfy $\sum_{i=1}^{10}x_{i}=50$ and $\sum_{i=1}^{10}x_{i}^{2}=340$. Two of the ten observations are chosen at random without replacement, all $\binom{10}{2}$ choices being equally likely, and $D$ denotes the square of the difference of the two chosen observations. Then the mean of $D$ is ______.
hindi: दस प्रेक्षण $x_{1},x_{2},\dots,x_{10}$ इस प्रकार हैं कि $\sum_{i=1}^{10}x_{i}=50$ तथा $\sum_{i=1}^{10}x_{i}^{2}=340$ है। इन दस प्रेक्षणों में से दो प्रेक्षण बिना प्रतिस्थापन के यादृच्छया चुने जाते हैं, सभी $\binom{10}{2}$ चयन समसम्भाव्य हैं, तथा $D$ चुने गए दोनों प्रेक्षणों के अन्तर का वर्ग है। तब $D$ का माध्य ______ है।
solution: Each of the $45$ pairs is equally likely, so $E(D)=\dfrac{900}{45}=20$ $\left(=\dfrac{2n\sigma^{2}}{n-1}\right)$
solution_full: Variance of the ungrouped data: $\bar{x}=\dfrac{50}{10}=5$ and $\sigma^{2}=\dfrac{1}{10}\sum x_{i}^{2}-\bar{x}^{2}=34-25=9$.
$D$ is a discrete random variable taking the value $(x_{i}-x_{j})^{2}$ for each of the $45$ pairs $i<j$ with probability $\dfrac{1}{45}$, so $E(D)=\dfrac{1}{45}\sum_{i<j}(x_{i}-x_{j})^{2}$.

Double sum: $\sum_{i=1}^{n}\sum_{j=1}^{n}(x_{i}-x_{j})^{2}=\sum_{i,j}(x_{i}^{2}+x_{j}^{2}-2x_{i}x_{j})=2n\sum x_{i}^{2}-2\left(\sum x_{i}\right)^{2}$. The terms with $i=j$ vanish and each pair $i<j$ appears twice, so $\sum_{i<j}(x_{i}-x_{j})^{2}=n\sum x_{i}^{2}-\left(\sum x_{i}\right)^{2}=n^{2}\sigma^{2}$.

$E(D)=\dfrac{900}{45}=20$. In general $E(D)=\dfrac{n^{2}\sigma^{2}}{\binom{n}{2}}=\dfrac{2n\sigma^{2}}{n-1}$, slightly more than $2\sigma^{2}=18$ because the two observations are distinct. (Example data: five values $2$ and five values $8$.)
originality_note: New: the mean squared difference of a random pair drawn without replacement from a data set equals n^2 sigma^2 / C(n,2), so the given sums fix it without knowing the data (way 4: a hidden identity linking a random variable to the data variance). Closest known: 'mean and variance from sum of x and sum of x^2' and the U-statistic identity in statistics courses. Different because: the student must build the random variable over pairs and reduce its mean to the data variance.

concept_use.Standard deviation and variance of ungro: The variance 9 of the ungrouped data (from the sums 50 and 340) gives the double sum n^2 sigma^2 = 900.
